source /opt/venv/bin/activate && python - <<'PY'
import json, pandas as pd

source /opt/venv/bin/activate && python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, json
snap = pd.read_csv('/workspace/tmp/screen_20261028/snapshot.csv', dtype={'code':str})
print(snap.columns.tolist())
print(snap.head(2).to_string())

codes=[n['code'] for n in d['names']]

sub = snap[snap[key].astype(str).str[:9].isin(codes)]
print('matched', len(sub), 'of', len(codes))

print(sub[cols].head(25).to_string(index=False))
PY

source /opt/venv/bin/activate && python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, json
snap = pd.read_csv('/workspace/tmp/screen_20261028/snapshot.csv', dtype={'code':str})
d=json.load(open('/workspace/analysis/screening_20261028_top20_1w/top20_1w.json'))
nm=pd.DataFrame(d['names'])
nm['c6']=nm.code.str[:6]
sub=snap.merge(nm[['c6','name','price','pe','pb','mktcap_yi']], left_on='code', right_on='c6', how='inner', suffixes=('_snap','_rep'))
print('matched', len(sub))
sub['px_diff']=sub.trade-sub.price
sub['pe_diff']=(sub.per-sub.pe).abs()
sub['pb_diff']=(sub.pb_snap if 'pb_snap' in sub else sub['pb_x']-sub.pb)
out=sub[['code','name_snap','trade','price','peak' if 'peak' in sub else 'price','per','pe','pb_x','pb_y','mktcap','mktcap_yi']].copy()
print(out.to_string(index=False))
print('\nmax |price diff|', sub.px_diff.abs().max(), '| max |pe diff|', sub.pe_diff.max())
print('ticktime sample', snap.ticktime.astype(str).str[:0].head(0))
print('snapshot ticktime max', snap.ticktime.astype(str).max())
PY

PY
